intro.line: First a dungeon, with goblins, dragons and a lot of loot. Then Innistrad, where the night stops ending.
Knew I'd find ye in trouble if I came out an' looked for ye!
The Forgotten Realms are a tabletop world. Innistrad is a gothic one. Both want you in their stories.

finale.line: Our kind has taken my gift for granted. It is time to correct that folly.
The wedding does not finish, and the night ends. Olivia's plan falls apart at the altar.
Recorded: the sun rises on Innistrad. Far away, something is still counting.

villainFinale.line: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.
In this version, the wedding goes ahead, and the night does not end.

portrait.card: Arlinn, the Pack's Hope // Arlinn, the Moon's Fury

battles.title: The Dungeon
battles.blurb: Bruenor and the party delve into a dungeon. The Cult of the Dragon is already down there.

scene.line: This one is for goblins, this one is for owlbears, this one is for toast, this one is for . . .
Courage is neither a shield nor an axe, but the will to wield both in defense of the innocent.
Dungeons: venture into the dungeon, and each room you reach does something. A deeper dungeon pays off the most.

villainScene.line: Red dragons consider the world and every creature in it as theirs to command.
In a hobgoblin's view of the world, the weak owe tribute and fealty to the strong.

hero.half: Venture when you can; deeper rooms pay more.

battles.title: The Wolves of the Ulvenwald
battles.blurb: Innistrad's night grows longer, and the werewolves roam. The cathars stand watch.

scene.line: Even in our darkest times, Avacyn's light still guides us.
Begone, moon-cursed! These folk are no prey of yours.
Day and night: it becomes night if a player casts no spells on their own turn, and day returns if a player casts two or more. Werewolves change with it.

villainScene.line: Do you smell that, friends? Fear and despair.
Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—

hero.half: Cast two spells in a turn to bring the day back.

battles.title: Crashing the Rehearsal
battles.blurb: Teferi slows the sunset to buy the town time. The wedding party has opinions about that.

cards.name: Dennick, Pious Apprentice // Dennick, Pious Apparition

scene.line: Here you go. Can't have you sleeping through your own wedding day.
The towers and catwalks of the Voldaren fortress are lit by the lanterns of geists endlessly seeking a way out.
Disturb: a spirit card can be cast again from your graveyard as its back face. Dying is only the first half of the plan.

villainScene.line: If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?

hero.half: Cast disturb cards from your graveyard.

battles.blurb: Arlinn leads the pack against a dungeon full of dragons.

Kessig Naturalist // Lord of the Ulvenwald

deck.name: Tiamat's Brood
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Tiamat herself is five colours, which our lands cannot support; her cult's dragons stand in.

scene.line: The ancient dragon Imvaernarhro has earned his fiery nickname.
Black dragons revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms.
Dragons are bigger than you. Race, or take down their fliers.

villainScene.line: Fire giants love to fight on a large scale, and Duke Zalto is one of the greatest warmongers of his age.
A simple fire spell that grows in intensity along with its caster.

battles.title: Sorin and the Bride
battles.blurb: Sorin goes to confront Olivia before the wedding. He is not the only one with a plan.

cards.name: Edgar, Charmed Groom // Edgar Markov's Coffin

scene.line: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.
Our kind has taken my gift for granted. It is time to correct that folly.
Planeswalkers: protect them with blockers, and attack Olivia's court before they bury you in blood.

villainScene.line: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.
You can join me or feed me. Choose fast.

hero.half: Guard Sorin and attack her board.

battles.title: Izzet Dragons
battles.blurb: Autumn 2021: Izzet dragons and a Delver against a green wolf pack.

scene.line: Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius.
If my hypothesis is correct . . .
Burn their wolves early. Your dragons can wait until the board is yours.

villainScene.line: With their usual prey scared off by werewolves, the wolves of the Ulvenwald adopted inventive new hunting techniques.
Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.

hero.half: Burn the wolves before they pile up.

battles.title: Rakdos Vampires
battles.blurb: Autumn 2021: Rakdos vampires against an Orzhov cleric deck.

scene.line: If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?
A duel to first blood means something very different when a vampire is involved.
Trade early removal for their clerics. Sorin turns the late game your way.

villainScene.line: Selûne guides her devotees with majestic wisdom and grace.
We are a product of our ancestors, the apotheosis of countless noble generations. Speak their names with reverence, and they will guide your path.

hero.half: Use removal on their best cleric.

battles.title: Olivia, Crimson Bride
battles.blurb: Olivia's wedding is the biggest night of the year. Kaya, Chandra and Teferi are going to crash it.

cards.name: Edgar, Charmed Groom // Edgar Markov's Coffin

scene.line: I'll lead.
And you were almost finished with that ritual, weren't you, darling? How very rude of me. To make it up to you, I'll send you an invitation to my wedding.
Her court is bigger than yours. Hit Olivia first.

villainScene.line: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.
You can join me or feed me. Choose fast.

hero.half: Hit Olivia before the court grows.

battles.title: Mono-White Humans
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a white deck that is out of cards by turn six and does not care.

archive.what: A white aggro deck built around Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, Brutal Cathar, Thalia and a stream of cheap Humans.
archive.why: Cheap efficient creatures, a strong exile effect, and Adeline's growing token army made it the fastest deck in the format.
archive.beat: Kill Adeline early, keep creatures back to block, and use sweepers if you have them.
archive.after: Innistrad: Crimson Vow and then Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty arrived and shuffled the format again.

deck.name: Mono-White Humans
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to.
Kill Adeline the turn she lands, or they will run you over.

villainScene.line: Thraben belongs to the living. I will not rest until it is cleansed.
